meta.storyTitle: Make the test sweep finish reliably without --test-force-exit

summary.prose: This Story makes bare parallel test sweeps terminate reliably without --test-force-exit. A finite default per-test timeout on the bare sweep entry point bounds every file (a straggler is failed at the bound and reported, never dropped), and the exec-stand-in test helper keeps its gh/git socket server ref'd while installed, so an awaited stand-in response cannot outlive the event loop and cancel the rest of its file. Product unref semantics (daemon housekeeping timers, session pool, mcp pipe) are deliberately untouched.

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Standalone bugfix Story (ISSUE-anchored, no parent HLD). Design directly against the repo: the harness (scripts/test-harness/run.mjs) is the owned bounded sweep path; bare globs need a per-test bound to finish reliably.

api.name: installExecStandIn

parameters.name: fn
parameters.purpose: stand-in handler; undefined removes the stand-ins

returns.meaning: PATH points at the stand-in bin dir (or is restored)

preconditions: called from a test file that spawns gh/git via execFile
postconditions: the stand-in server is listening AND ref'd (no unref before remove()), so awaited execFile responses keep the event loop alive

api.name: remove
postconditions: server closed, PATH restored, temp dir removed; the unref call is gone

dataModelChanges.details: The documented bare sweep entry point gains a finite default --test-timeout (e.g. an npm "test:sweep" script passing --test-timeout) so bare globs always carry a per-test bound; the harness remains the owned gate path with per-file budgets and the pinned --test-force-exit command. No stored data changes.

errorCases.scenario: A test promise never settles in a parallel bare sweep (event loop drained; only unref'd handles pending)
errorCases.detection: node:test reports "Promise resolution is still pending but the event loop has already resolved" and cancels the rest of the file; without a per-test timeout the parent sweep never terminates
errorCases.response: The default finite --test-timeout fails the stuck test at the bound and the file is reported; the exec-stand-in server staying ref'd removes the known loop-drain window for gh/git awaits
errorCases.userImpact: Bare npx tsx --test <glob> runs finish on every run with a complete per-file report instead of hanging to an external kill

errorCases.scenario: A file is merely slow under parallel load (compiler-API scans, e2e)
errorCases.detection: The per-test timeout fires ("test timed out after Nms")
errorCases.response: The file is reported failed-at-timeout and the sweep continues; a single-file rerun (as the headers recommend) passes
errorCases.userImpact: Slow-but-healthy files are visible as timeouts, not silently dropped

edgeCases.expected: unchanged; headers already recommend --test-force-exit for single files
unchanged: owned bounded child per file, pinned Node 22.22.1 command with --test-force-exit; the gate path is untouched

edgeCases.input: product code with unref'd housekeeping handles (session-pool sweep, state-store TTL, mcp session pipe, daemon children)
edgeCases.expected: untouched — unref stays so real daemons/hosts are not kept alive; only the test stand-in server changes

invariantsToPreserve.text: The harness remains the owned sweep path: one bounded child per test file with budgets, pinned runtime and --test-force-exit in the gate testCommand

Every test file still reports a result in a sweep; nothing is dropped

migrationSteps: note in docs/testing.md that bare globs should use the bounded invocation

alternativesConsidered.name: Default per-test timeout for bare runs
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Give bare tsx --test sweeps a finite per-test timeout so a straggler file fails at the bound instead of blocking the sweep forever.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Invocation/docs-level default --test-timeout (plus an npm sweep script that passes it); harness stays the owned sweep path; stragglers are reported as timeout failures, not dropped.
pros: Smallest change that makes every bare run terminate
cons: Does not repair the underlying unsettled promise

alternativesConsidered.name: Repair unref'd-handle awaits in test-reachable code
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Keep handles that tests await ref'd while work is in flight (exec-stand-in server, deadline timers).
alternativesConsidered.approach: exec-stand-in server stays ref'd until remove(); audit deadline timers on awaited paths; product unref semantics carefully scoped.
cons: Product-code unref changes risk daemon liveness

alternativesConsidered.name: Harness-only sweeps (docs only)
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Declare the harness the only supported sweep; change nothing.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Document that bare parallel globs are unsupported.

alternativesConsidered.name: Timeout default + test-helper ref discipline (combined)
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: a1 for guaranteed termination plus a2 scoped strictly to the test helper exec-stand-in (server ref'd while installed); product unref untouched.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Finite default --test-timeout in the documented bare sweep entry point + exec-stand-in keeps its server ref'd until remove().
cons: Cannot prove a rare race is gone, only bounded

epicImpact.reason: Standalone ISSUE-anchored bugfix; no Epic stories built yet.
epicImpact.findings: (a) awaited promises depending on unref'd handles can drain the loop under load; (b) no per-test timeout on bare runs lets one straggler file block the sweep forever. Harness already bounds each file.
